top_choice_rationale: Buchwald and Hartwig developed general, ligand-controlled palladium-catalyzed C-N coupling independently and in parallel. The mechanism is well understood (amine binding, deprotonation, suppression of beta-hydride elimination via ligand design), the method has about three decades of independent confirmation and daily use, and two names describe the credit completely. The 2010 overlap is answered only if the citation says 'general, ligand-controlled', and the exclusion of Kosugi, Migita, Guram and Rennels must be stated openly. Car-Parrinello has the cleanest credit and ranks second as the fallback; the PROTAC-only trio (P003) is the more coherent B014 option, ahead of the Handa version, which stretches three names over two lineages.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, but no connection to any credited laureate
